answer.short:
$OB=\sqrt{41}\,\mathrm{cm}$, $BX=4.5\,\mathrm{cm}$, $OX=\dfrac{7\sqrt5}{2}\,\mathrm{cm}$.

$\angle OBX=90^\circ$, $\angle BOX=35.1^\circ$, $\angle OXB=54.9^\circ$. See the labelled triangle.
answer.worked:
The rectangular base gives $CB=OA=5\,\mathrm{cm}$, and $BX=CY=4.5\,\mathrm{cm}$.

By Pythagoras in $\triangle OCB$,
$$\begin{align*}OB^2&=OC^2+CB^2\\OB^2&=4^2+5^2\\OB^2&=41\\OB&=\sqrt{41}\,\mathrm{cm}.\end{align*}$$
Since $BX$ is perpendicular to the base, $\angle OBX=90^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}OX^2&=OB^2+BX^2\\OX^2&=41+4.5^2\\OX^2&=\frac{245}{4}\\OX&=\frac{7\sqrt5}{2}\,\mathrm{cm}.\end{align*}$$
$$\begin{align*}\tan\angle BOX&=\frac{BX}{OB}\\\tan\angle BOX&=\frac{4.5}{\sqrt{41}}\\\angle BOX&\approx35.1^\circ\\\angle OXB&=90^\circ-\angle BOX\\\angle OXB&\approx54.9^\circ.\end{align*}$$
